notes.title: Street Dreams v1.1.0 is out now!
notes.content:
Having taken feedback from reviews, the game now provides more feedback to the player via a post-game report - allowing the player to easily review their performance.

The in-game score tracker has also been improved, it is now more visually appealing, can be read easier at a glance, and is positioned differently so its presence is more obvious.

The changelog can be found on the main menu under the 'documents' folder.

More changes will be coming [i]very soon[/i] - thank you everyone for playing Street Dreams!
